subject: Re: force reactive class back to data frame

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: force reactive class back to data frame
parts:
Are you trying to construct the TS object? Shouldn't it just be this?

TS <- reactive({
  TermStructure(rates = RatesData(), method = "ns")
})

And then wherever you were going to use TS, use TS() instead?

On Sun, Sep 25, 2016 at 1:08 PM <glennm...@me.com> wrote:
I have two functions that must work together

call some data then pass to another function as an object.  In the package it works as follows:
curve <- Rates(trade.date <- "08-15-2016")
TS <-  TermStructure(rates = curve, method = "ns")
    
In shiny this part works and I can output the table to my app
RatesData <- reactive({
      Rates(trade.date = input$tradedt)
    })

but now I need the second step to work
I have tried this  
curve <- function(){ x <- RatesData(); x <- as.data.frame(x); return(x)}

It does not work. I think this has something to do with putting curve in the right environment but I am at a loss

--
